queries.rawSQL:
select distinct j."if_octets" as Total,
          destination,
         case 
          when 'if_octets' = 'if_octets' then 'decbytes' 
          when 'if_octets' = 'if_packets' then 'prepackets' 
          else  'sishort' end as Unit
from (

  select  distinct cast("/value" as double) + cast("4/value" as double)  if_octets ,
          cast("1/value" as double) + cast("3/value" as double) if_packets,
          "/4/key" destination
        
  FROM TABLE(
      quickwit.system.raw_query(
      "query" => '*',
      "qwindex" =>'flows3',
      "columns" => '/value,1/value,4/value,3/value,/4/key',
      "replacefromcolumns" => '/3/buckets/4/buckets/1',
      "hasjs" => 'true',
      "start_timestamp" => '1778783640',
      "end_timestamp" => '1778787240',
      "aggs" => '[
                  histogram(field=span_start_timestamp_nanos, interval=144h, min=1, id=3),

                  terms(field=span_attributes.j, size=5, order=id:1:desc, min=1, id=4),
            
                  sum(field=span_attributes.u, id=1),
                  sum(field=span_attributes.t, id=11),
                  sum(field=span_attributes.ab, id=13),
                  sum(field=span_attributes.ac, id=14),
                  count(field=span_attributes.u, id=12)
                ]'
      )) as i
      where "1/value"  is not null
  -- select  distinct cast("/value" as double) + cast("4/value" as double)  if_octets ,
  --         cast("1/value" as double) + cast("3/value" as double) if_packets,
  --         "/4/key" destination
  --       from quickwit.metrics4."" as i
) as j 
order by  1 desc
limit 5
